title: Asymmetric Initialization Refinement
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining thickness initialization bounds to match the asymmetric geometry observed in route_02's highest-validity candidates will accelerate convergence toward better resonance matching, improving the target score beyond 0.620 without changing the fundamental 9L topology.
design_principle: Admittance locus method suggests that layer-by-layer thickness optimization benefits from physics-informed initialization rather than uniform starting points. The asymmetric thickness pattern (thick dielectric spacers, thin Cr-interfacing layers) observed in route_02 candidates indicates a cavity resonance condition that should be preserved during optimization.
proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | Cr | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Al substrate. Fixed 9 finite layers total.
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness bounds reflect deposition tolerance considerations
Cr layer thickness constrained to maintain partial transparency for cavity coupling
theory_basis: Admittance locus method for layer-by-layer reflectance prediction
Metal-dielectric cavity resonance for spectral selectivity
Physics-informed initialization from prior iteration candidate analysis
expected_advantages: Faster optimizer convergence due to informed initialization
Better resonance matching around proven physical geometries
known_risks: Over-constraining bounds may limit exploration of superior configurations
Same topology as route_02 may hit local optimum ceiling
Cr absorption may limit maximum achievable absorptance
execution_request_english: Optimize a 9-layer planar multilayer stack on Al substrate with air incidence. Stack sequence: HfO2 | SiO2 | Cr | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | SiO2. Use normal incidence, unpolarized light. Wavelength bands: 400-700 nm (maximize absorptance, minimize reflectance), 700-2000 nm (maximize reflectance). Thickness bounds: Layer 0 HfO2 [105, 135] nm, Layer 1 SiO2 [45, 75] nm, Layer 2 Cr [105, 135] nm, Layer 3 HfO2 [130, 190] nm, Layer 4 SiO2 [45, 75] nm, Layer 5 HfO2 [150, 210] nm, Layer 6 HfO2 [150, 210] nm, Layer 7 SiO2 [150, 210] nm, Layer 8 SiO2 [120, 180] nm. Initialize with midpoint of bounds. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer. Score candidates by weighted spectral performance across both bands. Total layer count fixed at 9. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 400-700 nm, 700-2000 nm. soft objectives: high absorptance in 400-700 nm; low reflectance in 400-700 nm; high reflectance in 700-2000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflectance in 400-700 nm; high absorptance in 700-2000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 20.
revision_reason: Constrained initialization bounds based on route_02's highest-validity candidate thickness distribution (Layer 0/2 ~120±15 nm, Layer 1/4 ~60±15 nm, Layers 5-7 ~180±30 nm) to refine resonance matching around proven physical geometries rather than re-exploring uniform baselines.
